text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan and I go to the Japanese Derby to watch Eishin Flash run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Eishin Flash may be far from the favorite to win, she overturns expectations and seizes victory. The stands erupt in excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It'd be difficult to get people as enthused for a race as the spectacle we just witnessed solely by promoting on social media.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Realizing this, Curren Chan grows determined to become cuter in order to win over the hearts of even more people.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hoping to gain the necessary skills to accomplish her goal, she decides to run in the Hakodate Sprint Stakes as part of her training.
